rules.name: Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) Order
rules.description: In Santhali, the verb consistently comes at the end of the sentence.

rules.name: Dual and Plural Number
rules.description: Santhali distinguishes between singular, dual (-kin), and plural (-ko).

example.native: ᱥᱮᱛᱟ (One dog), ᱥᱮᱛᱟᱠᱤᱱ (Two dogs), ᱥᱮᱛᱟᱠᱚ (Many dogs)
